svg.aria-label: Six steps: check, clean, stop, compact, verify, start again. Check and verify only read, clean removes only what you chose, stop stops the containers, compact is WSL's own. Under them the disk, 312 GB now and 248 GB after: its mint blocks, 64 GB, go back to Windows at the compact step.
